suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Align fullstack-worker skill adherence criteria with reporting expectations: require explicit manual verification evidence when interactive checks are mandatory, or relax the requirement when a feature cannot reasonably provide UI interaction evidence.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Across multiple photos milestone reviews (photos-picker-and-storage, fix-stream-storage-format, fix-photos-scrutiny), workers marked followedProcedure=true while handoffs repeatedly contained empty interactiveChecks despite skill-level requirements for manual verification.
